name: siyuan
description: Search, read, and edit a selected local workspace using the SiYuan CLI.

interface.longDescription: Use the SiYuan CLI installed on this computer to search, read, create, and edit notes in a workspace you select. Use a local conversation and choose the workspace when prompted. Note content used in a conversation is shared with OpenAI as conversation context.
defaultPrompt: Find my SiYuan notes about the launch checklist.
Create a meeting note in my SiYuan workspace.
Summarize the meeting notes and cite the originals.

publication.release_notes: Search, read, and edit notes with the installed SiYuan CLI in a local desktop conversation.
